A "UCP profile found" badge for your store

Stores where our latest crawl found a UCP profile can show it with a small badge that links to their ShopBot Index page.

(example)

Get your badge Does your store publish the profile AI shopping agents read (a UCP profile)? Look it up in our latest crawl (2026-10-19).

Rules

  • The badge is only offered for stores where our latest crawl found a profile at /.well-known/ucp.
  • Each badge is served from shopbotindex.com and is regenerated every week. If a later crawl no longer finds the profile, it turns into a neutral grey "ShopBot Index · view listing" badge.
  • No tracking: the badge is a plain SVG image, with no scripts or cookies.
